provenance_note: Sources studied are recorded privately by the author; no third-party text, prompts or code are reproduced.
behavioural_evidence: persona-level held-out test; modest gain on a cheaper model, no meaningful gain on a strong model
validation: Persona-level held-out test (23/11/2026): 25 sealed inert packages written independently of the skills; real agent with native skill loading; 3 trials per package; blind reading of unquoted findings. Cheaper model (Qwen3.8-Flash): planted issues identified 100% with the persona vs 94% without (the plain agent skipped one package in 3 of 3 trials); verdicts 75/75 vs 73/75 when 'approve with conditions' counts as correct for safe packages that could not be sandbox-tested; about 2x the time. Strong model (glm-5.3): no meaningful difference in detection (100% vs about 98%); about 3x the time. Structural gate (scripts/verify.py) passed at packaging time.
scope_notes: Measured as the full persona, not this skill alone.
Two models, one harness; no universal model or harness performance claim.
Verdicts are deliberately cautious: no sandbox test means no full approval.
